source_quotes: a sound methodology is one where all rules apply
if rules can or are optional it means it can be broken down and now this is where our refinement meta loops come in
methodologies list providers with rules and blueprint creation translates these
overlap_check: Rules review (docs/evidence/methodology-rules-review) found each defect class this addresses. No existing methodology states authoring rules. New; P3's meta-loop generalization is separate and not touched.

payload.name: Authoring a Sound Methodology
payload.description: A methodology is sound when every rule applies every time it is gathered. Rules are single concern, free of incident literals, invented providers and fixed caps, and name what they need per rule.

principles.name: All rules apply
principles.description: A rule that is optional is a sign the methodology should be split or refined.

principles.name: Rules become steps
principles.description: Providers and tools are declared per rule so blueprint creation can turn each into a step.

heuristics.condition: a rule is judged inapplicable by the rule gate
heuristics.action: treat it as a refinement candidate for the methodology, not as an exception

heuristics.condition: two rules in one methodology contradict
heuristics.action: resolve the contradiction before storing; a methodology cannot hold both

decision_rules.name: Test every rule against every use
decision_rules.condition: a rule is added to a methodology
decision_rules.outcome: check that it holds whenever the methodology is gathered; if it applies only sometimes, split the methodology or refine it

decision_rules.name: Keep one concern
decision_rules.outcome: keep it to one concern and put the description's words where the gather step matches on them, so a name used in another sense does not pull it in

decision_rules.name: No incident literals
decision_rules.condition: a rule is drawn from an incident
decision_rules.outcome: generalize it; do not carry container ids, task ids or one-off names

decision_rules.name: Declare real needs per rule
decision_rules.condition: a rule needs a provider, tool or pipeline
decision_rules.outcome: list it in that rule's requires with the right kind (provider for a server, tool for a tool name) and only names that are registered; anything else is a gap, not a requirement

decision_rules.name: Merge before adding
decision_rules.condition: a methodology on the same topic exists
decision_rules.outcome: add or refine in the existing one instead of creating a near duplicate, and send the overlap to the refinement loop

decision_rules.name: No unmeasured caps
decision_rules.condition: a rule states a numeric limit
decision_rules.outcome: remove it or state the measurement behind it
